plugins.name: quality-architect
plugins.description: Design and review software architecture against the ISO/IEC 25010:2023 product quality model (9 characteristics, 40 subcharacteristics), with a reference library of verified academic and official citations.

plugins.name: model-strategy
plugins.description: Cost-effective model and effort selection for Claude Code: a task-classification skill that recommends the optimal model (Fable/Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) and effort level, plus pre-configured Sonnet/Haiku subagents for cheap delegation, backed by official pricing references.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.description: Operational discipline for agentic development: handoff-driven delegation to external agents (Claude Code or Codex), skeptical auditing, fixed-rubric first-touch UX review loops, and crystallizing session learnings into lint/scripts/skills.

plugins.name: compact-plus
plugins.description: Preserve Claude Code session state before and after context compaction: transcript backup, LLM-generated state files, warn-threshold reminders, and post-compact recovery guidance. Ported from u-ichi/compact-plus (MIT).

plugins.name: second-opinion
plugins.description: Get an independent Fable/Codex review, or run an evidence-gated decision council with explicit dissent, model-role selection, missing-information checks, and accountable synthesis.

plugins.name: ios-build-optimization
plugins.description: Diagnose and optimize build times and module architecture for large iOS apps (Swift / SwiftPM / Xcode): classify bottlenecks from Build Timeline data, evaluate Target/Package/linkage decisions against the measured dependency graph, and emit evidence-labeled proposals with measurement plans.
